text: This document will show features / actions which are used on most of the backend transactions used on Purina V2.0 Ecosystem. Before starting using the specific playbooks read carefully this document.
All transactions described on this document and all other playbooks will required access to the site backend.
Ask for the administrator access to the site backend
To access the backend, enter the domain + “/user” , for example: https://dev-ef5-purina-latam-mx.pantheonsite.io/user/.

This feature will be used on all components and blocks where an image needs to be uploaded. It does not matter what kind of image, if desktop, mobile, background, article, product, for a card or hover, the procedure will be the same.
Añadir nuevo elemento multimedia		select a new image which was not uploaded previously
Añadir elemento multimedia existente	select a image which was uploaded previously. In this case, it is required to know the name of the file uploaded.

rows.text:
Nombre: file name which can be used later if the image can be used on another component or block.
Upload desktop and mobile image, if required.
For both, inform the “alternative text”.
Before moving forward, it is mandatory to click on “Crear element multimedia”, otherwise the image will not be saved.
After clicking on “Crear…” file name informed will be displayed like shown here with 2 actions available: “Editar” or “Eliminar”.

text: To create or change any new content, it is mandatory to save it. For that, click on “Guardar” on the top of the page. It does not matter the type of content.
To make the content available on the site or available to be used, it is mandatory, to click on  “Publicado” button to turn it on. See below.
To unpublish it, click on “Publicado” to turn off.

rows.text:
How the text will be positioned on the component.
Default = aligned left

Default – always red with white color
Outline – always white with black text
Secondary – always black with white text
Text – always black text

text: Define how the colored background will be shown. It can be a full background considering the whole screen extension or a “box” around the component.
Warning: to define the background height, use parameter “Spacing”. See more explanation on chapter “Spacing”.
This parameter allows us to define the spacing before and after the component itself. Pre-defined spacing rules:

rows.text:
Pre-defined spacing – same spacing will be applied before and after the component.
Each entry listed on the right is configured to have a specific component spacing which is showed as “ Xpx” where X is the number of pixels.

Pre-defined spacing – margins before/after will vary, including different values for desktop and mobile
Reference table on the right.
Example:
Espaçamento de seção: Grande will have the following spacing on:
Desktop: before = 40px / after = 80px
Mobile: before: 32px / after = 60px

text: Colors must be defined only when applicable.
